title: 工具缓存压缩交互与负结果：小型 factorial，缓存位置作为可构造的因子
hypothesis: E05 could only run two cells because it treated cache state as an uncontrolled provider property. It is not: inside one repetition block the first run of an arm meets a cold prefix and the second meets a warm one, so cache position is a factor we can construct rather than observe. The factorial asks whether compaction's cost depends on cache position (interaction), not only whether compaction is cheaper on average.

task_cluster_definition.cluster: one task is one cluster; every cell is measured on the same six tasks
task_cluster_definition.dev_suite_note: frozen dev suite, already used by earlier experiments; this is a new factor, not a new task set

factorial.bounded: 2 x 2 = 4 cells; the design does not enumerate further levels and stops at the declared run budget, which is what 'no infinite enumeration' means here
factorial.blocking: one repetition = one block; both arms run inside it, so the first arm in a block is cold and the second is warm. Arm order is randomized per block by the seed.

task_cluster_definition.holdout_suite_note: declared only because the gate requires a second path; this factorial consumes no holdout (holdout_policy.queries = 0) and suite-diag.json is never read by this run

model_identity_observability.note: same model all cells; cache_hit_ratio recorded per run as the check that the position factor did what it claims

quality_margin.rule: a quality claim requires a significant difference; an interval that crosses zero may not be written as non-inferior

noise_and_power_plan.plan: 24 runs; two blocks with randomized arm order; the factorial is analysed as main effects plus one interaction
noise_and_power_plan.statement: 6 clusters; the interaction is reported with its interval and a crossing interval is reported as inconclusive, never as non-inferior

cache_order_design.order: randomized within each block by the seed; position recorded per run
cache_order_design.warmup: none discarded - the first run of a block IS the cold cell, discarding it would delete the factor

stopping_rule: stop after 24 runs or 4 000k tokens, whichever comes first

holdout_policy.retirement_action: this is a within-suite factorial, not a confirmatory holdout; no holdout is consumed
holdout_policy.prior_use: dev suite reused deliberately so the new factor is the only change
